title: BenchmarkDefinitionValidator
responsibility: Validates versioned benchmark definitions and rejects duplicate paths, checks and candidates.

inputs.name: BenchmarkDefinitionValidator.validate.input
inputs.description: Untrusted definition before strict field, budget and duplicate checks.

outputs.name: benchmarkDefinitionSchema
outputs.description: Strict versioned schema including explicit candidates and bounded trial defaults.

outputs.name: BenchmarkDefinitionValidator.validate
outputs.description: Normalized benchmark definition with unique paths, check IDs and candidate IDs.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects invalid schema fields, unsupported candidate settings or duplicate identifiers.
